status.description: completed when the delegated scope is finished; blocked when it cannot proceed without the Lead.

summary.description: What was done, in a few sentences. No intermediate reasoning and no transcript.

evidence.description: Concrete observations that justify the summary: file paths, symbols, exact output lines. One item per observation.

changes.description: Files actually modified, one path per item. Empty when nothing was modified.

tests.description: Tests or checks actually run and their outcome, one per item. Empty when none were run.

risks.description: Known risks, gaps or uncertainties the Lead should weigh, one per item.

decisions_needed.description: Questions that require a Lead decision because they touch architecture, security, a public contract or an irreversible choice. One per item.

review_targets.description: Specific places the Lead should review first, one per item.
